id: title:Gilbert09:read worksheet headers in one request during discovery

review.posthog_relevance: Google Sheets warehouse ingestion: batching header requests to avoid Google API URL length limits and isolating unparseable-range errors to prevent complete ingestion failure.
review.reason: Adds batching and URL-length-bounded requests to Google Sheets warehouse ingestion, preventing API rejection and improving resilience against unparseable-range errors.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk P1.F1.H3; no broader context or test execution results available. Actual production benefit and recovery behavior are unverified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of implementation and checks, not just observation.

observations.behavior: Adds Iterator and urllib.parse.quote imports; gspread.utils absolute_range_name, fill_gaps, numericise_all; unparseable-range error helper; worksheet discovery and header reading refactored to batched, URL-length-bounded requests; unparseable-range errors no longer fail the whole batch; tests added for batching and unparseable-range handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Google Sheets warehouse ingestion: discovery and schema reading now batch header requests to keep URL length under 8000, avoiding Google API rejection; unparseable-range errors are isolated rather than failing the entire spreadsheet discovery.
